articles.title: Binance says MiCA should be judged by who it licenses, not who it excludes
articles.snippet: Europe head Gillian Lynch said Binance met Greece's licensing requirements and that the company remains committed to the EU, despite withdrawing its MiCA application days before the July 1 deadline.

articles.title: Securitize tokenizes $295 million of its own stock on Solana and Avalanche amid NYSE debut
articles.snippet: The newly-public company's shares are the largest issuer-sponsored tokenized stock at launch, aiming to make a point against rival third-party stock token issuers.

articles.title: A struggling Nasdaq-listed company that tried to copy Saylor's Bitcoin playbook is completely dumping crypto for AI
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq-listed Korean media company once lined up $1 billion in financing to buy 10,000 bitcoin. A recent filing confirms its balance is now zero as it pivots to AI infrastructure and fights to stay listed.

articles.title: ESMA warns many prediction market event contracts already face EU retail ban
articles.snippet: The European regulator said companies cannot circumvent EU financial rules by marketing binary-style products as event contracts rather than derivatives.

articles.title: EU crypto rulebook faces enforcement challenge as MiCA transition ends
articles.snippet: Lawyers and industry executives expect EU regulators to enforce MiCA differently as unauthorized crypto companies are required to wind down operations.
